# Neighborhood Commons API

> Open neighborhood event data. Free to read. Contribute with an API key. CC BY 4.0.

Base URL: https://api.neighborhood-commons.org
Spec: Neighborhood API v0.2 (https://github.com/The-Relational-Technology-Project/neighborhood-api)

## Quick Start

```bash
# Read events (no auth needed)
curl "https://api.neighborhood-commons.org/api/v1/events?limit=5"

# Get an API key (verify email, get key instantly)
curl -X POST https://api.neighborhood-commons.org/api/v1/developers/register/send-otp \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "email": "you@example.com" }'

# Then verify and receive key
curl -X POST https://api.neighborhood-commons.org/api/v1/developers/register/verify-otp \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "email": "you@example.com", "token": "12345678", "name": "My App" }'

# Contribute an event
curl -X POST https://api.neighborhood-commons.org/api/v1/contribute \
  -H "X-API-Key: nc_yourkey..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Open Mic Night",
    "start": "2026-04-15T19:00:00-04:00",
    "timezone": "America/New_York",
    "category": "open-mic",
    "location": { "name": "The Coffee Shop", "address": "123 Main St, Philadelphia PA" }
  }'
```

## Authentication

No auth required for reading. Pass `X-API-Key` header for writing and for a dedicated rate limit bucket.

Get a free API key: POST to `/api/v1/developers/register/send-otp` with your email, verify with the OTP code, receive your key immediately. No approval required.

New keys start at `pending` tier (events enter review queue). Tier upgrades (verified = auto-publish) are manual.

## Rate Limits

- Read: 1000 requests/hour per IP (or per API key)
- Contribute (pending tier): 20/hour, 100/day
- Contribute (verified tier): 100/hour, 500/day
- Contribute (trusted tier): 500/hour, 2000/day
- Standard `RateLimit-*` headers on every response

## Error Format

All errors: `{ "error": { "code": "ERROR_CODE", "message": "Human-readable explanation" } }`

Status codes: 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 429, 500.

---

## Read API (No Auth)

### GET /api/v1/events — List Events

Query parameters:
- `start_after` (YYYY-MM-DD) — events starting after this date
- `start_before` (YYYY-MM-DD) — events starting before this date
- `category` (string) — filter by slug (e.g., live-music, comedy)
- `tag` (string, repeatable) — filter by tag, AND logic
- `q` (string) — text search on name + description
- `near` (lat,lng) — geographic center point
- `radius_km` (number) — 0.1-100, default 10
- `collapse_series` (true/false) — deduplicate recurring series
- `series_id` (UUID) — events from a specific series
- `group_id` (UUID) — events from a specific group
- `recurring` (true/false) — filter recurring vs one-off
- `limit` (1-200, default 50), `offset` (default 0)

Response: `{ "meta": { "total", "limit", "offset", "spec", "license" }, "events": [...] }`

### GET /api/v1/events/:id — Single Event

Response: `{ "event": { ...full event object... } }`

### GET /api/v1/events.ics — iCalendar Feed

RFC 5545. Up to 200 events. DST-aware VTIMEZONE blocks. RRULE on series.

### GET /api/v1/events.rss — RSS Feed

RSS 2.0. Up to 50 events.

### GET /api/v1/accounts — Search Venues

Query: `q` (text search), `limit` (max 100, default 20), `offset`.

### GET /api/v1/accounts/:idOrSlug — Single Venue

Returns account with `logo_url`, `cover_image_url`, `regular_programming`, `upcoming_events`.

Slug is derived from business_name: lowercase, strip apostrophes, non-alphanumeric to hyphens.

### GET /api/v1/groups — List Groups

Query: `type`, `category`, `neighborhood`, `near` + `radius_km`, `q`, `limit` (max 100), `offset`.

Group types: business, community_group, nonprofit, collective, curator.

### GET /api/v1/groups/:id — Single Group

Returns group with venues and next 5 upcoming events.

### GET /api/v1/meta — Feed Metadata

Stewards, data sources, license.

### GET /api/v1/meta/regions — List Regions

Active regions with timezone and center coordinates.

### GET /api/v1/meta/categories — List Categories

Categories with event counts.

---

## Contribute API (Write — API Key Required)

Base: https://api.neighborhood-commons.org/api/v1/contribute
Auth: `X-API-Key` header

### Events

#### POST /contribute — Submit Event

Required: `name`, `start` (ISO 8601 with offset), `timezone` (IANA), `category` (slug), `location.name`.

Optional: `end`, `description`, `cost`, `url`, `image_url`, `tags` (max 15), `wheelchair_accessible`, `external_id`, `venue_id` (UUID), `recurrence` (RRULE), `instance_count` (0-52).

```json
{
  "name": "Tuesday Night Ride",
  "start": "2026-04-01T18:30:00-04:00",
  "timezone": "America/New_York",
  "category": "fitness",
  "location": { "name": "Frankford Hall", "address": "1210 Frankford Ave, Philadelphia PA 19125" },
  "recurrence": "FREQ=WEEKLY;COUNT=12",
  "tags": ["outdoor", "free", "beginner-friendly"]
}
```

Recurrence uses RRULE format. Supported: FREQ=DAILY, FREQ=WEEKLY, FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2, FREQ=MONTHLY, FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=2FR, FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE,FR. Append ;COUNT=N for bounded series.

Single event response: `{ "event": { "id", "status", "source" } }`
Recurring response: `{ "event": { "series_id", "instance_count", "instance_ids", "status", "source" } }`

#### POST /contribute/batch — Submit Up to 50 Events

Body: `{ "events": [...] }`. Response codes: 201 (all), 207 (partial), 400 (none).

#### PATCH /contribute/:id — Edit Your Event

All fields optional. Ownership enforced. Cannot change recurrence (delete and recreate).

#### GET /contribute/mine — List Your Events

Query: `status` (published, pending_review, unpublished), `limit`, `offset`.

#### DELETE /contribute/:id — Delete Your Event

Ownership enforced.

#### PATCH /contribute/events/:id/group — Link Event to Group

Body: `{ "group_id": "uuid" }` or `{ "group_id": null }` to unlink. Ownership enforced.

### Venues

#### POST /contribute/venues — Create Venue

Required: `name`, `address`. Optional: `lat`, `lng`, `place_id`, `phone`, `website`.
Dedup by slug — returns existing venue if match found (200 vs 201).

#### GET /contribute/venues — Search Venues

Query: `q`, `limit` (max 100), `offset`.

### Groups

#### POST /contribute/groups — Create Group

```json
{
  "name": "Philly Bike Train",
  "slug": "philly-bike-train",
  "type": "community_group",
  "category_tags": ["fitness", "outdoors"],
  "neighborhood": "Fishtown",
  "city": "Philadelphia"
}
```

Dedup by slug. Group types: business, community_group, nonprofit, collective, curator.

#### GET /contribute/groups — Search Groups

Query: `q`, `type`, `limit`, `offset`.

#### PATCH /contribute/groups/:id — Update Group

All fields optional except slug.

#### POST /contribute/groups/:id/venues — Add Venue to Group

Body: `{ "venue_name", "venue_address", "is_primary" }`.

#### DELETE /contribute/groups/:groupId/venues/:venueId — Remove Venue

---

## API Key Registration

### POST /api/v1/developers/register/send-otp

Body: `{ "email": "you@example.com" }`

### POST /api/v1/developers/register/verify-otp

Body: `{ "email": "you@example.com", "token": "12345678", "name": "My App" }`

Response includes `raw_key` — save it, shown once.

### GET /api/v1/developers/me — Your Key Info

Headers: `X-API-Key` required.

### POST /api/v1/developers/keys/rotate — Rotate Key

Requires current key + email re-verification via OTP.

---

## Webhooks

Subscribe to event changes. Requires API key.

Event types: `event.created`, `event.updated`, `event.deleted`, `event.series_created`

- POST /api/v1/webhooks — create subscription (returns signing secret once)
- GET /api/v1/webhooks — list your subscriptions
- PATCH /api/v1/webhooks/:id — update
- DELETE /api/v1/webhooks/:id — delete
- POST /api/v1/webhooks/:id/test — send test delivery
- GET /api/v1/webhooks/:id/deliveries — delivery history

Signing: HMAC-SHA256. Header: `X-NC-Signature: sha256=<hex>`.
Retry: 3 times (1min, 5min, 25min). 10 consecutive failures = auto-disabled.

```javascript
const crypto = require('crypto');
function verify(rawBody, signature, secret) {
  const expected = 'sha256=' + crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret).update(rawBody).digest('hex');
  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(signature), Buffer.from(expected));
}
```

---

## Event Schema

Every event response contains all fields. Absent values are null or [], never omitted.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| id | string | UUID |
| name | string | Event title |
| start | string | ISO 8601 with offset, DST-aware |
| end | string or null | Same format |
| timezone | string | IANA timezone (e.g., America/New_York) |
| description | string or null | |
| category | string[] | One-element array, kebab-case slug |
| tags | string[] | Experience/access tags, may be empty |
| place_id | string or null | |
| location | object | { name, address, lat, lng } |
| url | string or null | Event page or ticket link |
| images | string[] | Zero or one URL |
| organizer | object | { name, phone: null } |
| cost | string or null | "Free", "$10", "$5-15" |
| series_id | string or null | Links recurring instances |
| series_instance_number | number or null | |
| series_instance_count | number or null | |
| start_time_required | boolean | true = hidden after start, false = visible until end |
| wheelchair_accessible | boolean or null | |
| runtime_minutes | number or null | Film-specific |
| content_rating | string or null | Film-specific |
| showtimes | array or null | Film-specific |
| recurrence | object or null | { rrule: "FREQ=WEEKLY" } |
| source | object | { publisher, collected_at, method, license } |

Categories (20): live-music, dj-dance, comedy, theatre, open-mic, karaoke, art-exhibit, film, literary, tour, happy-hour, market, fitness, sports, outdoors, class, trivia-games, kids-family, community, spectator.

Tags (30): all-ages, 18-plus, 21-plus, family-friendly, free, cover-charge, donation-based, na-friendly, byob, dog-friendly, cash-only, registration-required, drop-in, limited-spots, solo-friendly, bring-gear, outdoor, rooftop, seated, chill, high-energy, late-night, beginner-friendly, themed, competitive, hands-on, tasting, acoustic, participatory, volunteer.
